name: What are the common signs that my kitchen faucet needs repair?

mainEntity.name: What are the common signs that my kitchen faucet needs repair?

acceptedAnswer.text: Common signs that your kitchen faucet needs repair include drips or leaks, reduced water pressure, unusual noises like grinding or squealing when turned on or off, and difficulty turning the handles. Persistent leaks, even small ones, can waste water and lead to higher utility bills over time. Addressing these issues promptly can prevent more extensive damage and costly repairs down the line, often involving simple part replacements.
acceptedAnswer.description: Look for drips, leaks, low water pressure, strange noises, or stiff handles. Addressing these promptly can prevent further damage.
